criteria.text: The traffic of a business application is mapped, and its owner confirms nothing is missing
criteria.how: Watch one application's flows for a week and review the map with its owner

criteria.text: An application policy enforced after a monitoring period breaks nothing, and blocks a connection it should block
criteria.how: Monitor, then enforce, then try a connection the application does not need

criteria.text: A machine flagged as compromised is quarantined in one step and can still be reached for forensics
criteria.how: Quarantine a test machine and open a forensic session to it

criteria.text: Test and production cannot reach each other, and the report shows it
criteria.how: Try a connection across environments and read the isolation report

criteria.text: A machine keeps its policy when it moves or fails over to another site
criteria.how: Migrate or fail over a labelled test machine and repeat a blocked connection

readiness: The applications in scope chosen, with their owners
A labelling scheme agreed: application, environment, role
Security agrees on a monitoring period before anything is enforced
A test machine allowed to be quarantined
Who to call if a policy blocks something it should not
